key_findings: Ketogenic diet/BHB relieves CCI neuropathic pain and microglial neuroinflammation in a SIRT3-dependent manner.
Sirt3 loss abolishes BHB effects on cytokines, mitochondrial function, UCP2/Pparg/PGC-1a and ketone-metabolizing enzymes.
